gripOrHq.title: Superglue
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Derez a piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Rent-I-Con
gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

gripOrHq.title: Little Black Box
gripOrHq.rulesText: Provides +1 MU and +1 hand size. Prevent up to 1 Net or brain damage each turn. Put [1] from the bank on Little Black Box when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for increasing your link. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn. Only one deck can be in play at a time. Trash any older decks.

heapOrArchives.title: Gypsy™ Schedule Analyzer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on R&D. If run is successful, do not access any cards. Instead, reveal cards one at a time from R&D until you reveal an agenda card or there are no cards left in R&D. Store the agenda, if any, in HQ and shuffle the other revealed cards, if any, into R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Panzer Run
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [4] and draw two cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Meat Upgrade
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Remove up to two tags, at no cost, and draw three cards. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Running Interference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

rig.title: Schematics Search Engine
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, expose all of the Corp's installed cards.

rig.title: Zetatech Portastation
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Zetatech Portastation when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for playing preps. If you use the bit, replace it from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Executive File Clerk
rig.rulesText: [2],[T]: Look at all cards stored in HQ. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Elena Laskova
rig.rulesText: Whenever you play a prep, gain an additional [1] the first time you gain bits from its effect. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.
